_policy: Fighter portraits: free license (CC0/PD/CC BY/CC BY-SA) or granted permission, author + credit recorded, image identity evidenced (Wikidata P18 of the matched boxer item, or the Commons description naming the boxer), boxer identity evidenced (Wikipedia/Wikidata person whose record includes the verified bout). Stored by PropBetEdge under web/public/media/boxers; never hotlinked. Usage: editorial identification on pages about the boxer only, never advertising, promotion or share images. Rule: commons_free_license_identity_evidence@1 (automated evidence rule, not a named human review).
